risks.risk: Hidden damage or wear not visible from front view

proof_requests: Photo of the back and sides of the unit, including power socket and any damage.
Video or photo of the unit operating with fan and water circulation.
Photo of all included components (remote, filters, tank lid, etc.).
Photo of the water tank removed and cleaned, or internal cooling pads.
Photo of the carton if available, or confirmation of its condition.
response.reason: The brand is confirmed, but the unit's functionality, condition, and included accessories cannot be verified from the front-only photos. Missing parts, hidden damage, and operational status are significant risks that must be proven before pricing.
